productionMode: faithful enriched variants of selected essence paintings
camera: same isolated near-frontal view as each base essence
provenance: Eight separate built-in imagegen edits preserve the selected base silhouettes and color families while adding brighter internal luminosity. Original full-resolution bases and new outputs remain private. Generated alpha is preserved through Lanczos downsampling and composited over the standard dark teal backing.
promptPrefix: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Rabbit Lands enriched essence inventory icon. Edit the supplied BASE ESSENCE artwork to make its rare ENRICHED version. Preserve the exact same school's recognizable silhouette, curled tip, broad painted planes, shape and color family, camera, orientation, single centered subject and full object. Enhance the inside with a substantially brighter luminous core, wider ivory-white highlights following existing painted folds, saturated luminous edges and a restrained soft halo close to the silhouette. The rare version must look visibly more concentrated and radiant at 50x50 pixels, while preserving dark and midtone planes so the shape does not wash out. Keep the original chunky hand-painted fantasy finish; no photorealism or smooth plastic. Remain one simple complete essence, square canvas with 15 percent safe margin. True transparent background, preserve alpha. No container, bottle, frame, labels, numbers, text, detached stars, scene, pedestal or extra objects.
